description.value: Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park is a Fraser Valley Regional District nature reserve near Rosedale, sitting in the floodplain below Cheam Peak. The wetlands support rich birdlife and offer a peaceful contrast to the nearby Trans-Canada Highway cycling corridor. For touring cyclists, it makes a worthwhile detour off the Chilliwack valley routes into quiet, flat terrain.
